name: TheRevenge
noteEs: Uno de los creators principales de Apex Legends en español, con cobertura de gameplay ranked, tutoriales y guías de legends accesibles. Audiencia primaria es la comunidad hispanohablante (España + Latam). Estilo didáctico, útil para players que prefieren content en su idioma nativo en vez de traducir conceptos de creators EN.
noteEn: One of the main Apex Legends creators in Spanish, with ranked gameplay coverage, tutorials, and accessible legend guides. Primary audience is the Spanish-speaking community (Spain + Latam). Didactic style, useful for players who prefer content in their native language instead of translating concepts from EN creators.
highlightsEs: Cobertura sostenida de Apex en español desde Season 1
Gameplay ranked con commentary en castellano accesible
Tutoriales por legend orientados a audiencia hispanohablante
Bridge entre meta global EN y community ES
highlightsEn: Sustained Apex coverage in Spanish since Season 1
Ranked gameplay with accessible Castilian commentary
Per-legend tutorials oriented to Spanish-speaking audience
Bridge between global EN meta and ES community
